outcome: Admission to intensive care units due to COVID-19
cohort: The study included 156 hospitalized female inpatients diagnosed with COVID-19, of whom 50% were pregnant, matched by disease severity, residence status, and age.
finding: Pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 exhibited significantly more severe clinical symptoms and encountered more adverse outcomes compared to their nonpregnant counterparts.
cross-section timing: Data collected between 15 July 2020 to 20 January 2022
